critique.change: At shot-08s, vary each strip's animation delay and curl amplitude by its column so the wave reads as a front crossing the grid instead of a repeated stamp of identical arcs.
Replace the flat radial ochre halos with a shared gradient or a per-strip tissue haze that brightens along the wave front, so the haze carries the mechanism rather than sitting as static blobs.
Remove the stair-step seams on tight curls at shot-20s by adding a segment overlap or a shading step on the inner face, so the end state reads as clean.
